data.name: TOX-17
data.detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

TOX-17 is a detective and investigation game where you analyze real video footage to uncover the truth behind mysterious incidents.

In the first case, an unknown person injects a strange substance into a product at a local market and disappears without a trace. The only evidence left behind is a collection of video recordings.

Your task is to carefully examine every clip, identify hidden clues, and follow the trail step by step.

Investigate:

• The country shown in the footage
• The city where the events take place
• The neighborhood and street
• The final location connected to the case

Every detail matters. Signs, architecture, vehicles, symbols, landmarks, and environmental clues can all lead you closer to the truth.

Features:

• Real video footage (FMV) investigation gameplay
• Multi-stage location deduction system
• Video controls for pausing, rewinding, and frame-by-frame analysis
• Note-taking and clue tracking mechanics
• Multiple hidden clues in every case
• Single-player detective experience

Observe carefully, connect the evidence, and uncover the truth behind TOX-17.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • Additional Notes: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended for the best investigation experience.
